note.title: Verbs and translation
note.overview: Read the finite verb first. Identify person, number and tense before assigning subjects, objects and preposition phrases.
learningGoals: Recall the taught forms and facts independently.
Apply them to translation and GCSE-style questions.
Use the answer and individual mark points to improve precision.
summary: Read the finite verb first. Identify person, number and tense before assigning subjects, objects and preposition phrases.
Present endings include -o/-m, -s, -t, -mus, -tis and -nt. Imperfect forms contain -ba- or -eba-: portabam, trahebant, audiebas.

Recognise completed perfect events in the stories: vidit, cucurrit, duxit and audiverunt. Imperfect forms describe ongoing or repeated past actions; natural English may use was/were …ing or used to ….
